title: The Beast Player
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ten-year-old Elin (Erin) lives with her mother, a beast doctor for the Toda, giant serpent-like creatures the kingdom rides into war. When the prized Toda die overnight, her mother is blamed and sentenced to death, and Elin is cast out to a distant land, relying on her mother's teachings and the kindness of strangers (Kodansha; Japan Society review of the source novel). The manga, adapted from Nahoko Uehashi's novels, follows her into adulthood, including a sanctuary for the winged Royal Beasts where she bonds with an infant beast.
life_message: Understand living creatures as they truly are, and keep your integrity when powerful people want to use that knowledge.
